## Problem

What problem does this solve? What's missing or awkward today?

## Proposed solution

What would you like to see happen?

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative approaches you've thought about, and why you prefer this one.

## Security / privacy impact

Does this touch permissions, network behavior, backup/data-extraction, or the Keep-Alive /
recovery state machine? If so, briefly describe the trade-off (KeepADB tries to request the
fewest permissions possible and to document why each one exists — see SECURITY.md).

## Additional context

Anything else — mockups, links, related issues.
